notes:
I couldn't do any research for Genesis 34 this time, so there are no notes to give you yet. My first attempt sent ten searches at once and went over the tool's usage limit. That used up all my search and page-reading calls for this turn, so I never got to read a single page.

Your rules say to report only what the pages actually say and to give a URL for every point. Writing notes from memory or guessing at URLs would break both, so I've left the notes empty rather than make anything up.

If you ask again, I'll search more slowly, a few at a time, starting with the verse-by-verse sources:
- **Main commentaries:** enduringword.com on Genesis 34, and the biblehub.com and studylight.org pages for Gill, Ellicott and the Pulpit Commentary.
- **Translation notes:** the netbible.org notes on verses 2, 7, 13 and 31.
- **Other evangelical sources:** preceptaustin.org and gotquestions.org on Dinah, Simeon and Levi.
- **Each tradition's own teachers:** Wesley's notes, Calvin and Reformed sermons (Ligonier, The Gospel Coalition), Lutheran and Pentecostal sources, and Catholic and Orthodox readings.
- **Modern scholarship:** bibleodyssey.org on how verse 2 and Dinah's own silence in the story are read.

A good way to start the next request would be "Continue with Enduring Word and the Bible Hub commentaries first." I'll then write the notes verse by verse with a URL after each point, adding the other sources in later turns if the limits are tight.
